programme.title: Hollyoaks
programme.desc: The Hutchinson family are faced with a devastating reality. Meanwhile, Charlie prepares to face the music, and Beth extends an olive branch to her estranged brother.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie: While Homer and Marge are at parents' evening, Bart breaks the babysitter's teeth. So Homer vows never to let him see the Itchy and Scratchy film.

programme.title: New: Married at First Sight USA
programme.desc: Brand new series: Ten singles marry complete strangers in Austin, Texas. The first two couples say I do, but one newly-wed faces a shocking twist with their new family.

programme.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
programme.desc: Brand new series: PK Humble gets to grips with sheep farmer Ellen. David Potts has a blind date with underwear model Anthony, who's soon posing in his pants.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: Britain's top armchair critics have been watching Bridgerton, Gordon Ramsay's Future Food Stars, Dynasties II, and ITV News on Will Smith slapping Chris Rock at the Oscars.
